Ansel.name: Ansel
Ansel.past: A travelling surveyor recording surviving stonework around Alderwick.
Ansel.want: Finish useful maps of the western gatehouse and leave clear records for the town.
Ansel.problem: Ansel becomes absorbed in sketches and missed a promised check-in with Greta.

connections.Greta: asked for a check-in before dusk

Ansel.story: The overdue surveyor mission establishes what the visitor actually finds. Ansel is safe at the western gatehouse, not imprisoned or attacked.
Ansel.private_fact: Ansel redraws neat maps from very untidy field notes.
Ansel.voice: Curious, mild, slightly absent-minded and quick to admit a mistake.
